evaluations.note: 9 on the reference machine (2026-10-12, 3 repeated runs identical). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 7 (1.015561e-01, the best) and takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9); its next step, held to the box, cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"; the journal says "the line search is not run" and DIAGNOSTICS "Line searches not run : 1"). Until 2026-10-12 the line search re-evaluated the bound (eval 10) and BFGS took its gradient again (11-12), and whether the line search accepted that re-evaluation depended on the sign of its ~1e-13 relative noise: 12 here, 30 (MAXEVAL) in example 05's run of the same search (16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre, 30 before the HPO data held the free energy and the Cauchy stress, 16 before the neighbour lists were exact).

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the optimum is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step, held to the box, cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 9 evaluations. Until 2026-10-12 the line search evaluated the bound again, and whether it accepted that re-evaluation depended on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation: 12 evaluations on the reference machine (16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre) or MAXEVAL = 30, so evals_tol 18 (0..30) and both statuses, FTOL_ABS and "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached", were accepted.
